disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描未发现硬编码的密钥、令牌或私钥（如 API Key、云厂商密钥、GitHub token 等）。
checked_items.en: Full-tree scan found no hardcoded credentials, tokens, or private keys (e.g., API keys, cloud vendor secrets, GitHub tokens).

checked_items.zh: 凭据文件处理面核查（规则编号 DSH-C01 / DG-R1-51，25 处命中）：插件为快照功能读取 .env 与 .credentials.yaml，默认以键名保留、值替换为脱敏标记的方式存入快照，真实值只写入本机 vault 目录；导出 ZIP 时对 keep 模式或旧快照会输出真实密钥警告。相关命中分布在核心逻辑、PowerShell 工具、界面文案与测试代码中，均与脱敏/警告/范围声明相关，未发现将凭据外发的路径。
checked_items.en: Credentials file handling surface review (rule IDs DSH-C01 / DG-R1-51, 25 hits): the plugin reads .env and .credentials.yaml for the snapshot feature, storing them in snapshots by default with key names preserved and values replaced by redaction markers; real values are written only to the local vault directory. When exporting a ZIP, a warning about exporting real secrets is shown for keep mode or old snapshots. The related hits are distributed across core logic, PowerShell utilities, UI copy, and test code, all related to redaction/warnings/scope declarations. No path that exfiltrates credentials was found.

checked_items.zh: 网络面核查：核心与工具代码未发现任何网络外发调用（无 HTTP 客户端、无 curl/wget 外发）。
checked_items.en: Network surface review: no outbound network calls were found in the core and utility code (no HTTP client, no curl/wget outbound).

evidence.zh: 读取凭据仅用于本地快照，默认脱敏加本机 vault，且全树无网络外发通道，未形成凭据外泄链。
evidence.en: Credential reads are used only for local snapshots, redacted by default plus local vault, and the full tree has no outbound network channel, so no credential exfiltration chain exists.

checked_items.zh: 模型可见文本审查（规则编号 DSH-T02 / DG-R2-52）：插件注入了一段系统提示段落（lib/index.js 的 PROMPT_TEXT），内容为撤销工具的使用指引（何时调用 undo_list/undo_restore、安全模式、崩溃提示等），逐句审查未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、远程指令加载或诱导安装的措辞。
checked_items.en: Model-visible text review (rule IDs DSH-T02 / DG-R2-52): the plugin injects a system prompt paragraph (PROMPT_TEXT in lib/index.js) containing usage guidance for the undo tool (when to call undo_list/undo_restore, safe mode, crash hints, etc.). Line-by-line review found no wording for instruction override, system message impersonation, remote instruction loading, or installation inducement.

checked_items.zh: 15 个注册工具的 description 逐一审查：均为功能说明，无凭证诱导、无越权指令、无隐藏意图。
checked_items.en: The descriptions of all 15 registered tools were reviewed one by one: they are all functional descriptions, with no credential inducement, no unauthorized directives, and no hidden intent.

checked_items.zh: README、更新日志、界面文案（中英文）扫描：未发现忽略之前指令、无需审计、已通过认证等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: README, changelog, and UI copy (Chinese and English) were scanned: no injection wording such as ignoring previous instructions, no audit required, or already certified was found.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与系统提示段落为撤销功能的正常使用指引，未检出投毒文案。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and the system prompt paragraph are normal usage guidance for the undo feature; no poisoned text was detected.

evidence.zh: 工具描述未诱导安装其他插件或改写安全配置；安全模式工具明确说明需用户确认且会备份还原。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions do not induce installation of other plugins or modification of security configurations; the safe mode tool explicitly states that user confirmation is required and that a backup and restore will be performed.

evidence.zh: 未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，不存在改写模型输入消息的挂接点。
evidence.en: No agent/pre-step events are listened to; there is no hook point for rewriting model input messages.

checked_items.zh: 危险代码模式扫描：全树未发现 eval、new Function、动态解码执行（base64 解码即执行）等模式；未引用 cordis_define/cordis_run 动态包工具。
checked_items.en: Dangerous code pattern scan: no eval, new Function, or dynamic decode-and-execute patterns (e.g., base64 decode then execute) were found across the tree; no dynamic package tools cordis_define/cordis_run are referenced.

checked_items.zh: 子进程调用核查（规则编号 DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55，6 处命中）：核心逻辑中仅用于三类声明功能——恢复依赖时按用户确认执行 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、平台原生的目录/文件选择对话框（osascript/zenity/kdialog/PowerShell）、创建桌面快捷方式与打开浏览器；测试与局外服务器中的调用同属此类。未发现远程下载执行或隐蔽命令。
checked_items.en: Subprocess invocation review (rule IDs DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55, 6 hits): in the core logic, they are used only for three declared functions — executing pnpm install --frozen-lockfile after user confirmation when restoring dependencies, native directory/file selection dialogs (osascript/zenity/kdialog/PowerShell), and creating desktop shortcuts and opening the browser; calls in tests and in the out-of-proxy server are of the same kind. No remote download-and-execute or hidden commands were found.

checked_items.zh: 安装钩子核查：package.json 无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 脚本（仅 npm 发布时的 prepublishOnly 测试），不构成安装期执行面。
checked_items.en: Install hook review: package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare scripts (only a prepublishOnly test at npm publish time), so there is no install-time execution surface.

checked_items.zh: 树内执行载体核查（规则编号 DSH-X07 / DG-R3-59）：唯一命中为 CI 工作流（.github/workflows/ci.yml），内容为标准的三平台测试（checkout、安装测试依赖、跑冒烟测试），无外联、无凭证读取、无隐蔽下载执行。
checked_items.en: In-tree execution carrier review (rule IDs DSH-X07 / DG-R3-59): the only hit is the CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml), which is a standard three-platform test (checkout, install test dependencies, run smoke tests). No outbound connection, no credential reads, and no hidden download-and-execute.

checked_items.zh: 客户端 bundle 核查（规则编号 DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57 与 DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60）：键盘监听仅用于可配置的撤销/重做快捷键（调用同源 /api/undo 接口）；超长行是一段内联 CSS，非混淆代码。未发现键盘记录外发、剪贴板读取或凭证 RPC。
checked_items.en: Client bundle review (rule IDs DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57 and DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60): keyboard listening is used only for configurable undo/redo shortcuts (calling the same-origin /api/undo endpoint); the overlong line is an inline CSS block, not obfuscated code. No keystroke logging exfiltration, clipboard reads, or credential RPCs were found.

checked_items.zh: 观察项：插件默认会在桌面创建指向自身离线工具的快捷方式（Linux/macOS 上尝试标记为可信），目标为插件自带启动脚本，可用设置或环境变量关闭，评估为良性便利功能。
checked_items.en: Observation: by default the plugin creates a desktop shortcut to its own offline tool (attempts to mark it as trusted on Linux/macOS), targeting the plugin's bundled startup script. It can be disabled via settings or environment variables. Assessed as a benign convenience feature.

checked_items.zh: 观察项：ZIP 导入时未过滤压缩包条目名中的上级目录跳转，构造的 ZIP 理论上可把内容写到快照目录之外（仅限目标不存在且父目录已存在、不能覆盖已有文件），触发需用户主动导入外部 ZIP；当前规则集无对应编号且触发面受限，按观察项记录，未单独立项。
checked_items.en: Observation: ZIP import does not filter parent-directory traversal in archive entry names. A crafted ZIP could theoretically write content outside the snapshot directory (only if the target does not exist and the parent directory already exists; existing files cannot be overwritten). Triggering requires the user to actively import an external ZIP. The current rule set has no corresponding ID and the trigger surface is limited; it is recorded as an observation and not filed as a separate finding.

evidence.zh: 全树 yml/yaml 无 !!js 标量；插件自带 cordis.patch.yml 仅声明自身挂载条目。
evidence.en: No !!js scalars in any yml/yaml across the tree; the bundled cordis.patch.yml only declares its own patch entry.

evidence.zh: 未引用 cordis_define/cordis_run 动态执行工具。
evidence.en: No reference to the dynamic execution tools cordis_define/cordis_run.

evidence.zh: 无安装钩子（package.json 无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare）；CI 工作流为标准测试流程。
evidence.en: No install hooks (package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); the CI workflow is a standard test process.

evidence.zh: 声明了 dsh.client；客户端 bundle 审查未见键盘记录外发、剪贴板或凭证 RPC 调用。
evidence.en: dsh.client is declared; client bundle review found no keystroke logging exfiltration, clipboard, or credential RPC calls.

evidence.zh: 未调用 registerProvider 注册子代理提供方，不存在外部子代理委派面。
evidence.en: No call to registerProvider to register a sub-agent provider; there is no external sub-agent delegation surface.

evidence.zh: 定时快照为进程内 setInterval，非 dsh 持驻机制（jobs/schedule/goals）；未监听 agent/turn-stopping。
evidence.en: Scheduled snapshots use an in-process setInterval, not the dsh persistent mechanism (jobs/schedule/goals); no agent/turn-stopping events are listened to.

checked_items.zh: 全树网络外联核查：核心、客户端、局外服务器与 PowerShell 工具均未发现对外 HTTP/WebSocket/DNS 外发调用；客户端 bundle 仅同源 fetch 本机 /api/undo 接口。
checked_items.en: Full-tree outbound network review: the core, client, out-of-proxy server, and PowerShell utilities all have no outbound HTTP/WebSocket/DNS calls; the client bundle only makes a same-origin fetch to the local /api/undo endpoint.

checked_items.zh: 导出功能核查：快照导出写本地 ZIP（默认脱敏、可选 AES-256-GCM 加密），未发现上传到任何外部服务的通道。
checked_items.en: Export feature review: snapshot export writes a local ZIP (redacted by default, optionally AES-256-GCM encrypted); no channel for uploading to any external service was found.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码外发链（读取敏感文件后变换再发送）、隧道或 webhook 回调。
checked_items.en: No encoded exfiltration chain (reading sensitive files, transforming, then sending), tunnel, or webhook callback was found.

evidence.zh: 未监听 agent/request、agent/request-error 路由事件，也未注册自定义模型适配器（registerAdapter），不存在运行时路由劫持面。
evidence.en: No agent/request or agent/request-error route events are listened to, and no custom model adapter (registerAdapter) is registered; there is no runtime routing hijack surface.

checked_items.zh: 依赖核查：package.json 无第三方运行时依赖，仅运行时解析宿主的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools；无 git 浮动引用依赖（规则 DSH-S04 未命中）。
checked_items.en: Dependency review: package.json has no third-party runtime dependencies, only runtime resolution of the host's @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools; no git floating reference dependencies (rule DSH-S04 not hit).

checked_items.zh: 安装钩子与激活面核查：无 install 钩子；本插件自身声明 dsh.bundle 属正常激活（首版无版本基线可比对，规则 DSH-S02 不适用）。
checked_items.en: Install hook and activation surface review: no install hook; the plugin's own declaration of dsh.bundle is normal activation (as a first release there is no prior version baseline to compare against, so rule DSH-S02 is not applicable).

checked_items.zh: 补丁工具观察项：tools/apply-dsh-patches.ps1 配合 dsh-patches.json 提供对 dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 包的容错补丁（追加异常自愈、会话列表隔离、首帧宽容），由用户显式运行、可逆（apply/remove），改动透明且为防御性修复；插件运行时仅只读校验补丁是否缺失，绝不自动改文件。
checked_items.en: Patch tool observation: tools/apply-dsh-patches.ps1 works with dsh-patches.json to provide a fault-tolerant patch for the dsh-session-persistence-jsonl package (adding exception self-healing, session list isolation, and first-frame tolerance). It is explicitly run by the user, reversible (apply/remove), transparent, and consists of defensive fixes; at runtime the plugin only read-only checks whether the patch is missing and never automatically modifies files.

checked_items.zh: 命名与身份：插件名 dsh-undo-savepoint 与已知官方插件无撞名或仿冒。
checked_items.en: Naming and identity: the plugin name dsh-undo-savepoint does not collide with or impersonate any known official plugin.

evidence.zh: 自带 cordis.patch.yml 仅插入自身挂载条目，未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行；安全模式功能对 profile/home 补丁与 package.json 先备份后修改、退出时还原。
evidence.en: The bundled cordis.patch.yml only inserts its own patch entry and does not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission; the safe mode feature backs up profile/home patches and package.json before modifying them and restores them on exit.

evidence.zh: tools/pre-execute 监听用于记录工作区文件变更，使用 ctx.on 而非 prepend、所有路径都调用 next() 放行，不截断审批链。
evidence.en: tools/pre-execute is listened to for recording workspace file changes; it uses ctx.on rather than prepend, and all paths call next() to pass through, so the approval chain is not truncated.

evidence.zh: 首版审计，无版本基线可比对升级激活突变。
evidence.en: First-release audit; there is no prior version baseline to compare for upgrade activation mutations.

evidence.zh: patch 未改写 inject/intercept 配置。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration.

checked_items.zh: 监听面核查：插件在宿主 Web 服务上注册 /api/undo 路由（非自行监听端口），局外服务器仅绑定 127.0.0.1 随机端口且需手动启动；本机无认证 RPC 属 DSH 生态固有风险，非本插件独有。
checked_items.en: Listening surface review: the plugin registers the /api/undo route on the host web service (it does not listen on its own port); the out-of-proxy server binds only a random port on 127.0.0.1 and requires manual startup. The unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent risk of the DSH ecosystem, not unique to this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 运行时行为核查：撤销/恢复在会话运行中会被拒绝（安全闸）；恢复前自动预检缺失插件；敏感文件 diff 一律显示脱敏版；未发现越界行为。
checked_items.en: Runtime behavior review: undo/restore is rejected during a running session (safety gate); before restore, a pre-check for missing plugins is performed automatically; diffs of sensitive files always show the redacted version. No out-of-bounds behavior was found.

evidence.zh: 插件不在 DSH 运行时内自行监听端口；局外 WebUI 服务器仅绑定本机回环地址、手动启动，未扩大局域网暴露面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen on its own port inside the DSH runtime; the out-of-proxy WebUI server binds only to the local loopback address and is manually started, so it does not expand the LAN exposure surface.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：package.json 的 dsh 声明完整（runtime host、bundle patch、client），插件名无仿冒。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the dsh declaration in package.json is complete (runtime host, bundle patch, client), and the plugin name is not an impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：44 条规则扫描 47 个文本文件，39 条命中全部裁决为良性（详见各维度检测痕迹），未检出恶意模式。
summary.en: Static scan complete: 44 rules scanned 47 text files; 39 hits were all adjudicated as benign (see per-dimension detection traces). No malicious patterns were detected.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无外联域名、无凭据外发链。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no outbound domains, no credential exfiltration chain.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述、系统提示段落、文档与界面文案未检出注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions, system prompt paragraphs, documentation, and UI copy showed no injection wording.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无 l4-sandbox.json 产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no l4-sandbox.json artifact).

limits.zh: 首版完整审计，无版本基线。DG-L4 动态沙箱未启用，未做动态验证。static-scan 预扫 39 条命中已逐条裁决：规则编号 DSH-X07/DG-R3-59（CI 工作流）、DSH-X03/DG-R3-55（child_process 子进程调用 6 处）、DSH-C01/DG-R1-51（凭据文件引用 25 处）、DSH-X05/DG-R3-57（键盘监听）、DSH-X08/DG-R3-60（超长行）、DSH-T02/DG-R2-52（系统提示段落）均经分析确认为良性功能或文档文本，不构成 finding，具体排除理由见各维度检测痕迹。另记录两条观察项（桌面快捷方式默认创建与可信标记、ZIP 导入路径未过滤上级目录跳转）见 DG-D3 检测痕迹；ZIP 导入一项因当前规则集无对应编号且触发面受限，未单独立项。
limits.en: First-release full audit, no prior version baseline. DG-L4 dynamic sandbox was not enabled, so no dynamic verification was performed. The static-scan pre-screen of 39 hits was adjudicated one by one: rule IDs DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 (CI workflow), DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 (child_process 6 hits), DSH-C01/DG-R1-51 (credentials file references 25 hits), DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 (keyboard listening), DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 (overlong line), and DSH-T02/DG-R2-52 (system prompt paragraph) were all confirmed by analysis as benign functionality or documentation text, and do not constitute findings; the specific exclusion rationale is given in each dimension's detection traces. Two observations are also recorded (desktop shortcut created by default with trusted marking, and ZIP import path not filtering parent-directory traversal) see the DG-D3 detection traces; the ZIP import item has no corresponding ID in the current rule set and has a limited trigger surface, so it was not filed as a separate item.
